landing.det1Desc: Detects volumetric Denial-of-Service patterns by observing passive traffic flow statistics. Classifies high-volume packet anomalies and SYN flood patterns.
landing.det2Desc: Identifies reconnaissance and port-scanning behaviour from passive connection telemetry. Tracks sweep patterns across observed source/destination pairs.
landing.det3Desc: Analyses passive DNS query patterns to detect domain generation algorithm (DGA) activity and DNS-based data tunneling. Operates solely on observed DNS telemetry.
landing.det4Desc: Classifies encrypted session metadata to identify botnet Command-and-Control beaconing and malware communication within TLS flows without decrypting payloads.
landing.det5Desc: Detects anomalous outbound data volumes that are consistent with data exfiltration. Relies on passive flow-level byte and packet counters.
landing.det5Method: Statistical baseline deviation + River adaptive model

about.subtitle: विभीनेत्र ही रिअल-टाइम पॅसिव्ह धोका ओळख प्रणाली आहे.
about.whyPassiveText: In industrial control systems (ICS/SCADA), tactical networks, and high-security air-gapped zones, networks are often coupled via physical data diodes or unidirectional mirrors. Because packet injection can trigger emergency faults, active probes or inline blocking devices are prohibited. Passive detection ensures zero operational interference.
about.phi1Text: We observe telemetry passively. Network state changes remain the sole authority of the administrator.
about.phi2Text: Every threat alert is presented alongside exact network logs, confidence values, and timeline summaries.
about.phi3Text: Analyses are performed on headers, connection parameters, and TLS handshakes, respecting privacy and encryption limits.
about.invariantsSubtitle: To guarantee architectural compliance, the following actions are strictly outside Vibhinetra's domain:
about.inv1Text: The system does not transmit packets into the monitored network segment.
about.inv2Text: Actions like firewall modifications, route changes, or socket drops are never executed automatically.
about.inv3Text: Vibhinetra relies entirely on passive mirrors (SPAN ports) or external export logs (NetFlow/IPFIX).
about.inv4Text: Network sessions are analyzed using structural header features and TLS handshake indicators.

capabilities.subtitle: Vibhinetra uses five specialized, logical detector modules running on normalized streaming telemetry to identify the six core cyber threat capabilities.
capabilities.archNoteText: Detectors are logical analysis modules residing in a single pipeline, NOT decoupled microservices. This guarantees low processing latency and prevents synchronization bottlenecks.
capabilities.det1Desc: Analyzes high-volume flow trends and packet frequencies. Flags protocols exhibiting severe payload asymmetry or anomalous packet counts indicating flooding behaviors.
capabilities.det1Signals: Packet arrival intervals, TCP packet sizes, byte-to-packet ratios, host-flow counts.
capabilities.det1Evidence: SYN flood pattern match: 42,000 requests observed from a single subnet in a 10s window.
capabilities.det2Desc: Identifies sequential network profiling sweeps and host scans. Detects remote entities probing active subnets or sweeping across connection ports.
capabilities.det2Signals: Sequential connection failure rates, host-port distribution metrics, UDP scanning frequencies.
capabilities.det2Evidence: Horizontal port scan targeting internal /24 subnet. 85 failed socket connections.
capabilities.det3Desc: Monitors UDP/53 and TCP/53 lookups. Flags anomalies in domain entropy indicating Algorithmically Generated Domains (DGA) or TXT query size shifts indicating active exfiltration tunnels.
capabilities.det3Signals: DNS name character entropy, DNS response sizes, TXT query record ratios, query frequencies.
capabilities.det3Evidence: High entropy DNS TXT query tunnel detected. Query sizes exceed baseline averages by 800%.
capabilities.det4Desc: Inspects handshake structures of encrypted TLS connections to expose command-and-control beacons and malware signatures without decrypting payloads.
capabilities.det4Signals: Client JA3/JA4 signatures, server certificate validity, packet jitter profiles, periodic connection intervals.
capabilities.det4Evidence: Command & Control beaconing identified. Outbound TLS flows exhibit a strict 30s interval with 0% jitter.
capabilities.det5Desc: Evaluates outbound traffic sizes. Compares transfers against historical baselines of standard internal entities to flag unauthorized payload transfers.
capabilities.det5Signals: Unidirectional payload volume, outbound session durations, protocol transfer baselines.
capabilities.det5Evidence: Anomalous outbound transfer of 4.2GB payload. Historical host baseline is 10MB per 24 hours.

architecture.title: Unidirectional Data Pipeline
architecture.subtitle: Vibhinetra uses a decoupled, high-performance architecture to ingest, normalize, analyze, and present network threat intelligence without altering telemetry pathways.
architecture.gatewayText: For operational security and architectural integrity, the browser never communicates directly with Redpanda streams, Redis Pub/Sub, or the PostgreSQL database. All query transactions, session authentication, and WebSocket live feeds are brokered exclusively by the FastAPI Backend Gateway.
architecture.flowSubtitle: Telemetry travels strictly one-way from the network mirrors to the analyst dashboard.
architecture.phase1Item1Desc: Raw packets are passively mirrored via network SPAN ports or physical hardware data diodes.
architecture.phase1Item2Desc: Zeek decodes mirrored traffic into rich protocol logs (HTTP, DNS, SSL, etc.) without interacting with entities.
architecture.phase1Item3Desc: Unidirectional routers export layer-3 flow data, which bypasses Zeek to load balancer directly.
architecture.phase2Item1Desc: Converts multi-source network signals into a unified data contract matching the Canonical Event Schema.
architecture.phase2Item2Desc: Buffer telemetry logs into decoupled streaming queues (e.g. topic connections, topic dns) to prevent packet loss under stress.
architecture.phase3Item1Desc: Applies sliding windows to stream vectors, building behavioral metrics (like connection rates, domain entropy).
architecture.phase3Item2Desc: Runs tabular ML models (XGBoost) and sequential stream classifiers (River) to flag threat vectors.
architecture.phase4Item1Desc: Validates classifications, checks thresholds, assigns confidence, and formats detailed evidence packets.
architecture.phase4Item2Desc: The durable source of truth. Every alert must successfully insert and await database COMMIT.
architecture.phase4Item3Desc: Once persistent commit is completed, the alert is published to the Redis channel to trigger browser notifications.
architecture.phase5Item1Desc: Serves secure dashboards via HTTP REST endpoints and feeds live alerts to clients over WebSockets.
architecture.phase6Item1Desc: A dense console rendering live WebSocket feeds, detailed evidence lists, and triage workspaces for SOC analysts.
